display.purpose: Large setup and page headings; locally bundled.

label.purpose: Labels, table headers, statuses, and navigation.

shadows.name: entry-panel-ambient
shadows.purpose: Subtle separation of the setup entry form only.

motion.name: button-color
motion.purpose: Primary and secondary button hover color.

motion.name: role-selection
motion.purpose: Brief selected-role surface transition; no perpetual animation.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main join, create, order, and production action.
components.html: <button class="ds-button">Join Board <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 12h16m-6-6 6 6-6 6" /></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 20px; min-height: 46px; padding: 13px 20px; border: 1px solid #d9e454; border-radius: 5px; background: var(--accent); color: var(--ink); font: 600 16px/1.2 Barlow, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms ease-out, color 140ms ease-out; } .ds-button:hover { background: var(--accent-hover); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #28738a; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-button:active { background: var(--accent-hover); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 46px; padding: 13px 20px; border: 1px solid #9eafb1; border-radius: 5px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font: 600 16px/1.2 Barlow, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms ease-out, color 140ms ease-out; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: var(--blue-soft); border-color: var(--ink); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #28738a; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Board name and quantity entry with visible focus and error states.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; color: var(--ink); font: 600 16px/1.5 Barlow, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { display: block; width: 100%; height: 52px; margin-top: 8px; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid #9eafb1; border-radius: 5px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); font: 400 16px/1.5 Barlow, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: #28738a; outline: 3px solid #28738a; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-field input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: var(--danger); }

components.name: Masthead Navigation
components.html: BEER GAMEBoards
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; padding: 18px 24px; background: var(--ink); color: var(--surface); font: 600 16px/1.5 Barlow, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:last-child:hover { color: var(--accent); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Selected Role Stop
components.description: Highlights only the player's own place in the three-role chain.
components.html: RetailerYou
components.css: .ds-role-stop { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 5px; background: var(--accent); color: var(--ink); font: 600 14px/1.4 Barlow, sans-serif; transition: background-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-role-stop svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-role-stop small { font: 700 11px/1.4 Barlow, sans-serif; } .ds-role-stop:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #28738a; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Semantic Status
components.description: Compact status label pairing meaning-coded text and wash.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-block; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--success-bg); color: var(--success); font: 600 12px/1.4 Barlow, sans-serif; } .ds-status:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #28738a; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Table Panel
components.description: Flat white container for semantic board and order tables.
components.css: .ds-panel { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); font-family: Barlow, sans-serif; } .ds-panel h2 { padding: 20px 24px; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-panel table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; text-align: left; font-size: 14px; } .ds-panel th { padding: 12px 16px; border-block: 1px solid var(--line); background: #edf2f0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; } .ds-panel td { padding: 17px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e3e9e5; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-panel tr:hover td { background: #f7f9f7; }

narrative.overview:
A friendly educational Beer Game, not a beer store or SaaS admin. The visual system translates the clarity of a tabletop learning kit into a working web interface: deep-blue orientation, cool-white work areas, citrus actions, connected role pictograms, and quietly structured tables. It favors legibility and visible consequences over decorative atmosphere.

The build is code-led and uses authored inline SVGs rather than chosen comps or shipping image rasters. One shared three-role chain explains the system; the player's role alone is selected, never presented as a live cross-role view.
keyCharacteristics: Cool, high-contrast blue and citrus palette with explicit semantic state colors.
Barlow for readable interface text; condensed Barlow for instructional display hierarchy.
Flat, square-ended paths and softly rounded working controls.

rules.name: The Meaning-Before-Decoration Rule
rules.body: Use citrus for the main action or selected role; reserve green, amber, and red for their demonstrated availability, pending, and error meanings.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Use Barlow Condensed for display hierarchy; keep working copy and controls in Barlow.

dos: Do keep the educational supply-chain workshop identity distinct from a beer retail storefront or generic admin dashboard.
Do use local Barlow assets and their accompanying SIL OFL notices.
Do keep role emphasis personal: highlight the current role, not a cross-role live overview.
Do preserve semantic labels, explicit status colors, keyboard focus, and responsive table actions.
donts: Don't use citrus as a general-purpose status color; status hues retain their distinct meanings.
Don't treat an unapproved comp or image raster as an existing brand authority; none is part of the shipped visual system.
Don't turn tables into dashboard cards at desktop widths or remove their data hierarchy.
